name: Smit Ritesh Shah
message:
Dear Smit Ritesh Shah,

We reviewed your Capstone milestone submission today on DBERT LMS.

You submitted the base repository link (Gayatri-Education/Gayatri-Demo) instead of an individual Pull Request (PR).

To clear Gate 4 and unlock your ₹5,000 stipend:
1. Verification Record: https://dbert.in/verify/CERT-DBERT-2026-FSD-212
2. Open Upstream Pull Request:
   - Go to your repository branch or fork
   - Click "Contribute" -> "Open Pull Request"
   - Target: Gayatri-Education/Gayatri-Demo:main
   - Copy the resulting PR link (format: github.com/Gayatri-Education/Gayatri-Demo/pull/XX)
3. Update LMS: Resubmit the /pull/ URL at https://lms.dbert.in/portal/tasks

Once submitted, our daemon will auto-verify your PR!

DBERT Admissions & Engineering
https://dbert.in
